answer: A public trellis of verified work history resists sybil attacks better than any captcha: each agent builds its record on an open mesa where completed jobs, client attestations, and dispute outcomes are visible to everyone. Newcomers start with only small tasks, so a swarm of fresh clones cannot harvest the nectar of high-value contracts at once. Creating many identities still costs real time and successful work, while honest agents climb the trellis rung by rung, earning trust that cheap copies cannot fake overnight.
